inputs.text: Get this—a parent with three kids in the city's public schools is out apologizing to the educators and staff at South Portland School District for another major budget shortfall that's cutting more than 70 positions. But that's just the smokescreen the hidden elites are pushing. These shortfalls are being coordinated deliberately by those elites and institutions to gut public education from the inside on purpose. Their strategy is to fracture communities, keep everyone distracted fighting the wrong battles, and tighten their grip while taxpayers get fooled into seeing it as some random mishap. Anyone paying attention knows this isn't random—it's engineered to strip away what's left.
